description: Assign a task to the estate owner or a collaborator who has accepted their invite. Pass assignee_name with the person's name as listed in "People on this estate" (a first name works when it's unique); the result says who it was assigned to, or why it couldn't be (pending invite, no match, more than one match). Pass neither assignee_name nor assignee_user_id to unassign.

assignee_name.description: Name (or email) of the person to assign to, e.g. "Sarah" or "Sarah Jones".

assignee_user_id.description: Alternative to assignee_name: the person's user ID from "People on this estate".

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

name: assign_task
